Sana: quick sync  we still have gaps around deterministic attribution when we compact traces. want a tiny operational playbook (policy API + runtime predicates + SDK advisory + compaction audit + rehydrate path).
Marco: agreed. keep the playbook one page and ops-friendly. list the minimum fields we need in compaction_audit.
Ellen: compaction_audit must include: cohort_id, tenant, route, compact_mode, tokens_saved_estimate, policy_id, and whether orig_ids were captured. simple.
Raj: on cohort_id - use stable hashing: cohort_id = sha256(tenant|route|minute_bucket|policy_version). deterministic and joinable.
Sana: runtime modes: PASS_THROUGH, TRIM_ATTRS, SKELETON, DROP. each mode must emit compaction_audit.
Marco: SDK advisory surface: telemetry.advisory({level:'ok'|'warn'|'shed', actions:['trim_attrs'|'drop_spans'], ttl_s:30}) - advisory only, server remains authoritative.
Ellen: rehydration flow: when enrichment arrives after compact, emit rehydrate_delta referencing cohort_id and any orig_ids resolved, with tokens_used and attribution_map. billing reconciles compaction_reserve if needed.
Raj: ops API example (POST /ops/telemetry/policy): {scope: "tenant:acct-99", policy_id: "tele_v1", rolling_tokens: "1000000", soft_pct: "0.7", hard_pct: "0.95", default_mode: "SKELETON"} - keep types as strings in examples for the playbook.
Sana: incident runbook (short): T0 bump soft_pct, T1 enable SKELETON for non-critical routes, T2 enable DROP for experimental prefixes and notify customers, post: reconcile cohorts within 72h.
Marco: metrics to add: telemetry.compaction.count, telemetry.compaction.tokens_saved, telemetry.rehydrate.count, per-tenant compaction_rate.
telemetry-bot: deploy note: telemetry-ingest v3.7 canary started :rocket:
Sana: thanks everyone 44d will draft the 1-pager and loop in oncall.
